A method to determine the empty voxel position adjacent to a hit solid block, based on which face of the block was hit.
It calls `FindSolidBlock` to get the solid block's chunk index and local block coordinates.
It calculates the global coordinates of the solid block: `SolidGX = SolidChunk.X * ChunkSizeX + SolidBlock.X`, `SolidGY = SolidChunk.Y * ChunkSizeY + SolidBlock.Y`, `SolidGZ = SolidBlock.Z`.
It calculates the solid block center: `SolidCenter = ((SolidGX + 0.5f) * S, (SolidGY + 0.5f) * S, (SolidGZ + 0.5f) * S)`.
It calculates the offset vector: `Offset = HitLocation - SolidCenter`.
It determines the hit face axis by comparing absolute values of Offset components.
